verdict.rationale: Databricks documents a CLI explicitly for use 'from your local terminal or automation scripts', a Python SDK to 'automate Databricks operations', and a full versioned REST API reference with CLI, Terraform, and SDK examples. Together these provide first-party headless, scriptable control of the platform without the UI. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs (e.g., pipeline runner setup or non-interactive service-principal auth), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CI usage.
